decisions.title: Runtime activation is not approved
decisions.decision: Runtime activation is NOT APPROVED. No ACTIVE lifecycle, no INSTALLED lifecycle, no resident runtime, no supervisor or daemon, no background process, no global runtime binding, no automatic activation, and no machine-global installation.
decisions.reason: Neither ACTIVE nor INSTALLED is defined in any specification, the lifecycle state machine is still a placeholder, and nothing in P1-P5 requires a persistent runtime. An ACTIVE flag with no executable observer would repeat the exact defect that blocks CAP-P03-005 at Gate F.
decisions.binding_state: The four production capabilities remain lifecycle_state EVALUATED. CAP-P03-005 remains DEFERRED / NOT_PROMOTED. CONF-001 remains UNRESOLVED.
